data.headline: Thirty-year Treasury yield rises to 5.30%
data.summary: The thirty-year yield rose one basis point on November 24 while the ten-year fell one. The gap between them widened from 37 to 39 basis points.

bull.text: The ten-year yield eased to 4.91%, one basis point below its November 23 reading.

bear.text: A rise in long-maturity yields lowers the price of a fixed-rate bond when other inputs are held constant.

watch.text: Asset managers were net long 371,794 Treasury bond futures contracts on November 17, down from 394,990 the week before. That positioning report predates the November 24 yield move.

limitations: The Treasury curve tracks benchmark yields. The CFTC release tracks futures positions. TLT’s session return requires independently verified ETF prices.
